name: latexdetok
description: Diagnostics for LaTeX sources, underlined as they are typed, from the latexdetok language server.

latexdetok.serverPath.markdownDescription: The command that starts the server. `pip install latexdetok[lsp]` installs it; give the whole path when it is not on the `PATH` VS Code sees, for example `~/Envs/Main/bin/latexdetok-lsp`.

latexdetok.language.description: The language of the messages. The diagnostic codes never change.

latexdetok.followInputs.markdownDescription: Read the definitions of the files the document loads (`\input`, `\usepackage`, `% !TEX root`). Off, a macro that opens an environment passes for unbalanced.

latexdetok.expand.markdownDescription: Expand the macros of the document before diagnosing. Off, `\beq … \eeq` passes for unbalanced.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The diagnostics work, but the command that starts the server is taken from the user settings only.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The server reads the files a document loads, so it needs them on disk.
